**ACCEPT** — `domain:devx @ objectui` seat, PM session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, R46, reviewed 2026-09-07T22:18Z against GitHub and the tree.

## The central claim reproduces, verified here

`packages/vscode-extension/package.json`'s `contributes` holds seven keys — `commands, configuration, grammars, jsonValidation, languages, menus, snippets` — and **`keybindings` is not one of them**. The extension ships zero keyboard shortcuts, exactly as the card says. The dev's positive control is the right shape: with no contributed shortcuts to control on, it controlled on what the manifest *does* contribute (`exportToReact` → 6 hits over the same corpus, plus a full manifest read-back), so the zero is a reading rather than a broken search.

⚠️ One loose number, correctly reported rather than inherited: the title says five shortcuts; there are **four distinct chords across six assertion sites**. And three of the card's six line numbers had drifted since `59a3a233d` — every site was re-located by content.

## ⭐ The finding: the card AND its triage were wrong about the rest of the page, and the naive fix would have routed readers through the error

Both say the six commands are "reachable from the Command Palette and the context menus, **which the page also documents correctly**", and route the reader there. Measured against `contributes`, that is false three ways:

1. **Palette names.** The page taught `ObjectUI: …`; every manifest title says `Object UI: …` — and two differ by more than the space (`Open Preview`, not `Preview Schema`; `Export to React Component`, not `Export to React`). No command carries a category, so the palette shows the title verbatim.
2. **Context menus.** `contributes.menus` gives `editor/context` three commands and `explorer/context` one. The page listed a fourth editor entry and a second explorer entry, neither contributed — and omitted that every entry is `when`-restricted to `.objectui.json` / `.oui.json`.
3. **Preview column.** `objectui.preview` calls `showPreview(uri, false)` → `ViewColumn.One`; only `previewToSide` gets `ViewColumn.Beside`. The page described "Open Preview" as opening in a side panel.

⇒ Writing *"use the Command Palette or the context menu instead"* on top of that would have been **a new false sentence inside a card about false sentences** — the exact failure this dispatch warned about, hit at one remove for the third time today. All three corrected as a declared bounded in-place fix.

## The direction fence held

Verified: the diff is **one file**, `content/docs/utilities/vscode-extension.mdx` (`+38/-35`). ⛔ Nothing in `contributes` changed. Whether any of the four chords *should* ship is left as a product decision on its own card, ⛔ not taken here — which is the whole point of the fence.

## ⭐ A green ablation with a control leg that fires — the discipline this lane keeps asking for

Re-injecting the deleted shortcuts table left **all eight** doc gates at exit 0 and vitest at 5 files / 212 tests green ⇒ nothing pins this page against the manifest. On its own that green is ambiguous — it could mean the harness never reads the file. So the dev mutated `"type": "h1"` → `"type": "heading"` in the **same file** and turned `check-doc-component-types.test.ts` **RED** (exit 1, AssertionError naming the file).

⇒ The harness demonstrably reads this file and can fail on it; it simply has no manifest comparison. **That is what makes the first green a measurement instead of an absence.** Both legs proved on disk before any result was read, and restored by blob-hash equality and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## The pin judgement is the right one

⛔ No gate built. A guard re-deriving `contributes` against this one page would be a new surface for a single document, and the general shape — *a document mirroring something no tool re-derives* — is already the cluster #7976 / #7974 / #7837 names. If it earns a gate it should be the generic one over `content/docs`, decided with a maintainer on its own card. ✅ Correct restraint, and it is stated as a judgement with its reason rather than as an omission.

⚠️ #8424 (the page's `keybindings.json` example rebinds `ctrl+shift+p` over the Command Palette in exactly the file type where the same page says to press it) was filed with **no labels**; this seat added `finding`. An observation card without it is invisible to the grading sweep. ⛔ No `domain:*` — that is triage's.

Changeset: none owed, by the gate's own verdict. Not governed surface; PR stays draft.

Next: CI converged all green (28 checks, read 22:15Z) → flip → post-flip guard → SQUASH → queue → landing probe (no `Ctrl+Alt` chord anywhere in the page; the six command ids present and spelled as the manifest spells them; control: `contributes` still has **no** `keybindings` key — if it ever gains one, this page becomes wrong in the opposite direction) → LANDED here and on #8113, which closes via `Fixes`.

LANDED — merged into `main` at 2026-09-07T22:33:58Z as `34510e0c3` (squash), read 22:34:03Z. #8113 closed `completed` via `Fixes`.

**Content probe on re-fetched `origin/main` (tip `34510e0c3`, read 22:35Z):**

1. **All four fictional chords are gone** — `ctrl+alt` / `cmd+alt` matches **0** times across the page, from the six sites that asserted them.
2. **The command names now match the manifest byte for byte** — `Object UI: ` (with the space) appears **17** times and the wrong `ObjectUI: ` spelling **0**. ⭐ This is the half the card and its triage both got wrong: they said the palette route the page documents was correct, and it was not. A fix that removed the chords and pointed readers at the palette without this would have routed them through a broken replacement.
3. **Control — `contributes` still has no `keybindings` key** (7 keys, unchanged). ⚠️ That single fact is what the whole rewritten page now rests on, and nothing pins the two together: an ablation re-injecting the shortcuts table left all eight doc gates green, while mutating `"type": "h1"` in the same file turned a test RED — so the harness reads this file and simply has no manifest comparison. If the extension ever contributes a keybinding, this page goes wrong in the opposite direction, silently.

⛔ Nothing in `contributes` changed. Whether any of those four chords *should* ship stays a product decision on its own card — ⛔ not taken here, which was the fence that decided this dispatch.

⚠️ Open and ⛔ not closed by this: **#8424** (the page's `keybindings.json` example rebinds `ctrl+shift+p` over the Command Palette in exactly the file type where the same page tells the reader to press it — valid, not false, so deliberately left byte-identical) and the generic-pin question, which belongs with the #7976 / #7974 / #7837 cluster and a maintainer, ⛔ not a bespoke gate for one document.
